Our story

Built around the work farmers do every day

Agrotech Agriculture Industry began its journey in 2005 with a clear purpose: develop practical agricultural equipment for real field requirements.

From our base near Model City in Jhang, the product range now supports seeding, harvesting, soil preparation, field shaping, maintenance and precision land levelling. We continue to combine useful engineering with clear guidance and responsive customer support.
